title: Log MCP boot exit-1 failures early and add headless codesearch.bat / incremental index tool
goal: Make MCP crashes diagnosable and align CLI/MCP indexing entrypoints with headless agent workflows

sections.what: In session transcript (2026-11-14T01:34:25+01:00, L831/L832), parallel codesearch MCP tool calls failed with "server name codesearch failed to load: exit status 1" with no crash traceback recorded in C:\Users\Tommy\.codesearch\mcp.log because file logging is only configured inside _open_index/_trace_tool (mcp_server.py:73-74, 99, 137). In addition, agent instructions reference `codesearch.bat index` or MCP indexing, whereas F:\AI\codesearch only ships interactive start_codesearch.bat (which unconditionally boots CUDA sidecar + web UI + pause) and mcp_server.py has no incremental index/refresh tool.
sections.why: Uncaught boot exit-1 crashes are invisible to diagnostics, and agents have no headless batch wrapper or MCP mechanism to update stale files in the index after edits.
sections.how:
1. Initialize diag/file logging at the very top of src/codesearch/mcp_server.py (around FastMCP boot / __main__ entry) with a top-level exception hook writing uncaught startup tracebacks to ~/.codesearch/mcp.log before exiting.
2. Provide a minimal headless codesearch.bat (forwarding subcommands like `codesearch.bat index` cleanly to `python -u -m codesearch`) distinct from the interactive CUDA+serve start_codesearch.bat, and optionally expose a safe MCP incremental refresh tool (text/AST/keyword index + optional embed) for modified files.
sections.verify:
1. Force an import/startup exception during mcp_server boot and confirm the traceback is written to C:\Users\Tommy\.codesearch\mcp.log.
2. Run headless `codesearch.bat -r F:\AI\viwo\virtual-world index --no-embed` (or similar headless subcommand) without starting CUDA sidecar or pausing on the web UI server.

acceptance.text: MCP server startup/import exceptions are written cleanly to ~/.codesearch/mcp.log (or boot error log) instead of vanishing on exit status 1
A lightweight headless codesearch.bat / CLI entrypoint runs index without forcing CUDA image sidecar startup or web UI serve+pause
An optional MCP tool (or index freshness flag in search_code/codesearch_stats) lets agents trigger or request incremental indexing on modified files without shelling out to missing batch wrappers
